title: Yummy Juicy Japanese Fish Fillet Okonomiyaki
description: A sweet and juicy Japanese dish featuring fish fillet, infused oil, and okonomiyaki, perfect for a romantic dinner, and is FODMAP friendly.
instructions: Preheat a large non-stick skillet or okonomiyaki pan over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together the okonomiyaki flour and water until smooth.
Add the shredded cabbage, chopped green onion, bonito flakes, soy sauce, sesame seeds, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix well.
Add the fish fillet to the bowl and gently fold into the okonomiyaki mixture.
Brush the preheated skillet or okonomiyaki pan with the infused oil.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the okonomiyaki mixture into the skillet or okonomiyaki pan.
Cook the okonomiyaki for 4-5 minutes on the first side, until the bottom is golden brown.
Flip the okonomiyaki over and cook for an additional 4-5 minutes, until the other side is also golden brown.
Serve the okonomiyaki hot and enjoy.
Garnish with additional green onion, sesame seeds, and bonito flakes if desired.
